title: System Status - No "Sensor Start/Age" display after xdrip update
symptom: After an automatic xdrip update to version dfcbe80-2024.09.17, the Classic Status Page no longer displays the sensor start date and sensor age. This occurs with both 'Libre (patched App)' and 'Nightscout Follower' data sources. Reinstalling the previous version restores the display.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. Navid200 speculates that xDrip may not know when a Libre session started because the session runs on the Libre device, not xDrip, but this is not confirmed.
fix: The thread does not state a final fix. A PR (#3750) was opened but marked as draft pending discussion. The user found that reverting to the previous version (06.11) restored the display, but this is a workaround, not a fix.
evidence_quote: I reinstalled the previous version again, to make sure it's an xdrip issue. It is - previous version instantly showed sensor start date and age again.
